lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a defined 2D grid of approximately 6 vertical columns and 6-8 horizontal rows on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, with the highest-intensity circular blobs positioned at the intersection points of these bands and horizontal alignment axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, each exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient transition (high-luminance upper edge, low-luminance lower edge) extending from the post-cephalic region toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast pixel clusters (associated with Echeneidae) located ventral to the primary pectoral fin.
